changes: Added an independently authorized topology critic role, signed hash-bound critic receipts, separately authorized exclusion approvals, production read-only verification, exhaustive fail-closed mutation coverage, and a fast real producer-to-verifier live acceptance transcript.
usage: Run `node bin/lattice.js topology_critic_receipt_set ...` from an eligible independent critic, then `node bin/lattice.js topology_critic_receipt_check --storyId=B-9123`; use `node packages/main/dist/tasks/proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.js --live-happy` for the bounded live acceptance chain.
expectedOutcome: Topology critic eligibility: PASS with all four independence dimensions true; Topology critic receipt: PASS with check=ok and semanticOk=true.
actualTranscript: Topology critic eligibility: PASS role=lattice-review-topology-critic independence=agent:true,session:true,dispatch:true,businessCommitAuthor:true; Topology critic receipt: PASS check=ok semanticOk=true.
outcomeDiff: No material difference between the expected user-visible result and the recorded live transcript.
limitations: Wave 2A only: critic receipts are signed CLI-verifiable artifacts and do not yet create the Wave 3 pre_review_check lifecycle admission gate. A real story with unsupported discovery correctly produces request_changes rather than a false PASS.
pitfalls: The first real transcript correctly exposed an unsupported acceptance basis and refused false-green delivery. A production-chain synthetic fixture also failed task binding, so the fix used a real isolated repository and a bounded --live-happy path. The default 900-second aggregate timeout aborted the 46-command validation while tests were still progressing; rerunning the single instance with supported LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 completed 46/46 PASS.
